extra.message: User-controlled input 'name' is formatted directly into SQL query using string formatting (% operator). The query 'INSERT INTO students (name) VALUES ('%(name)s')' is built by string interpolation without parameterization. This allows SQL injection through the student name field when creating a new student via POST /students/.

cwe: CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

extra.message: Jinja2 template autoescaping is explicitly disabled (autoescape=False). This makes the application vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) as user-controlled data from database (course titles, descriptions, review text, student names) is rendered without escaping in templates like course.jinja2, students.jinja2, and courses.jinja2.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: MD5 hash function is used for password hashing. MD5 is cryptographically broken, vulnerable to collision attacks, and extremely fast which makes brute-force and dictionary attacks trivial. Passwords should be hashed using bcrypt, scrypt, or Argon2.

cwe: CWE-916: Use of Password Hash With Insufficient Computational Effort

extra.message: CSRF middleware is commented out, leaving all POST endpoints vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery attacks. Forms include CSRF tokens ({{ csrf_token() }}) but the server-side validation is disabled. An attacker can trick authenticated users into performing unwanted actions like creating students, courses, reviews, or evaluations.
Application is configured with debug=True in production code. Debug mode can expose sensitive information including stack traces, environment variables, and application internals through error pages.

cwe: CWE-215: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Debugging Code
CWE-538: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Externally-Accessible File or Directory

extra.message: Session cookie is configured with httponly=False, making it accessible to client-side JavaScript. If an XSS vulnerability exists, attackers can steal session cookies and hijack user accounts.

POST /students/ endpoint has no authentication or authorization check. Any unauthenticated user can create new student records. While the template conditionally shows the form to authenticated users, the backend endpoint is unprotected and can be accessed directly.

cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

extra.message: POST /courses/ endpoint has no authentication or authorization check. Any unauthenticated user can create new course records. While the template shows the form only to admin users, the backend endpoint has no protection.

cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

extra.message: POST /courses/{course_id}/review endpoint has no authentication or authorization check. Any unauthenticated user can create course reviews. The endpoint accepts POST requests without verifying the user is logged in.

extra.message: POST /students/{student_id}/evaluate/{course_id} endpoint has no authentication or authorization check. Any unauthenticated user can create/modify student marks/grades. While the template shows the form only to admin users, the backend is unprotected.
